home.heroSubtitle: Fresh seasonal produce, wine from our own harvest and passionate cooking in the heart of Los Realejos wine country.
home.locationBody: In La Cruz Santa, among vineyards and valleys, we cook every day with local ingredients and the character of an authentic northern Tenerife guachinche.
home.wineBody: Listán Negro and fruity white from our barrels, served by the jug to accompany stews, meats and fish of the day.

1.descripcion: Gratinated semi-cured goat cheese with homemade red and green mojo sauces.

2.descripcion: Chickpea stew with ribs, chorizo, black pudding and seasonal vegetables.

3.descripcion: Crispy croquettes made every morning with the day's filling.

4.descripcion: Traditional Canarian escaldón with fish stock, onion and toasted gofio.

5.descripcion: Jug of red or white wine from our harvest, served ice cold.

6.descripcion: Slow-marinated pork ribs with wrinkled potatoes and roasted pineapple.

7.descripcion: Pork pieces sautéed with cumin, garlic and paprika, traditional style.

8.descripcion: Juicy Iberian secreto grilled to perfection, with potato garnish.

9.descripcion: Chicken marinated in Canarian salmorejo, roasted and served with potatoes.

10.descripcion: Confit cod with poached onion, paprika and bay leaf.

11.descripcion: Fresh wreckfish with onions, potatoes and mild mojo.

12.descripcion: Crispy white fish churros with aioli and lemon.

13.descripcion: Creamy biscuit and cream dessert, very popular in the Canary Islands.

14.descripcion: Canarian flan with condensed milk, homemade caramel and lemon zest.
